Definition: Light — physical light and, figuratively, truth, purity and life; used of God, of Christ as Light of the world, and of His people.
BiblicalUsage: Phos opens John's Gospel: the life was the light of men, and the darkness has not overcome it. Jesus claims the title, then astonishingly gives it to His followers: 'You are the light of the world.'
TheologicalSignificance: Phos is hope with a guarantee: darkness never wins. The Light has come, still shines, and now shines through ordinary people in ordinary places.
